objective: Recompute M505 dead-write-only single-port product capture against the strongest implementable M468 strong-zero point and the same-coordinate M473 bit point on one frozen ledger; the M473 fused concurrent-1R1W point is an opportunity ceiling, not a rejection denominator.

frozen_coordinate.population: 10 samples x 4 bottleneck Conv3x3 x 432 partitions x 3000 rows
frozen_coordinate.arithmetic: exact signed12 parent/residual and signed19 resident psum
frozen_coordinate.candidate_parent_port: one 1152-bit synchronous 1RW SP access per cycle: read XOR write
frozen_coordinate.candidate_response: one-cycle synchronous response, two reserved entries, no same-cycle consume credit

capacity_recompute.rule: The result must fail if any matcher, directory, response queue, liveness metadata, or ping-pong store that is a memory capacity obligation is omitted or if the total exceeds 240 KiB. Standard-cell logic area is reported separately and is never converted into free SRAM bytes.

aggregate: cycles for M468 strong-zero, M473 same-coordinate bit, M505 dead-write-only, M505 combined, and M473 fused ceiling
speedup of M505 dead-write-only versus both implementable baselines
port tax versus the M473 ceiling, labeled diagnostic
all on-chip capacity by logical and macro-rounded item
weight DRAM bytes, source/descriptor bytes, parent scratch read/write bytes, DMA commands, and commit cycles
arithmetic issue, parent edge, active row, and completion conservation
distribution: per sample and per operator candidate/baseline cycles
arithmetic mean, geometric mean, minimum, maximum, and coefficient of variation
no summing of operator-isolated pipeline slices as a sample-major total

cpu_decision_gates.gate_interpretation: Passing authorizes one bounded dead-write-only 1RW RTL implementation preflight. Failing closes the RTL line. The 5 percent distance from the unphysicalized M473 ceiling is reported but is not a CPU GO/NO-GO gate.

bounded_next_rtl_if_cpu_passes.candidate: dead-write-only 1RW parent scratch; retain existing same-address RAW forward; do not implement combined PVRF single-use store elision
bounded_next_rtl_if_cpu_passes.reason: Dead-write-only and combined PVRF have identical 435293339 cycles; combined removes only 244346 additional one-block writes and requires richer reference-class metadata.
required_physical_gates: Exact directed and randomized Synopsys VCS/SVA for one-read-XOR-one-write arbitration, one-cycle response, queue full, same-address forward, dead-store suppression, backpressure, reset, wrong identity, overflow, and completion conservation.
Trace recurrence must remain within 1 percent of 435293339 cycles and retain at least 1.50x versus both 760350133 and 757946784 baselines.

Integrate the nine generated TSMC28 128x128-bit 1RW macro views; include the matcher, scheduler, directory, liveness bitmap, response queue, resident psum interface, and all adapters. Logic-only or zero-macro area is not a passing result.
At 3.000 ns, setup, hold, max capacitance, max transition, and max fanout must all be clean under conservative macro and interconnect timing; Formality must pass.
Against a matched strongest-zero/bit wrapper, local throughput per total area must improve by at least 1.10x and total capacity must remain at or below 240 KiB.

SAIF/PTPX plus generated-macro read/write energy and DRAM energy must show either at least 20 percent four-Conv energy reduction or at least 1.25x EDP improvement; report the 30.457 GB all-eight-block parent-scratch movement rather than hiding it.
All results remain four-Conv local until decoder-complete system integration and multi-sequence evaluation.

fail_closed: Do not call concurrent 1R1W and single-port 1RW the same port contract.
Do not reject the realizable single-port point solely because it is more than 5 percent slower than the unphysicalized concurrent-1R1W ceiling.
Do not call 1.746753x or 1.741232x RTL, physical, full-network, or system performance.
Do not promote combined PVRF as a cycle mechanism because its cycle count equals dead-write-only exactly.
